evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:91,95,129,148,152,186 — six internal navigations are done with `window.location.href = '/registry/pets/...'` / `/registry/vehicles/...` (view, edit, new for both pets and vehicles) instead of React Router. Every click triggers a full browser page reload inside a Vite SPA: the TanStack Query cache is dropped, all in-memory app/auth/router state is lost, and the JS bundle is re-downloaded and the app re-bootstrapped.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/compliance/pages/ContentModerationPage.tsx:207 — same anti-pattern for case detail: `window.location.href = `/compliance/moderation/cases/${caseId}`` (handleViewContent), with an explicit `// TODO(Phase-2): Use React Router's useNavigate` comment acknowledging it.
Contrast (correct usage): IntegrationsPage.tsx:355 uses window.location.href = res.auth_url for an EXTERNAL OAuth redirect, which is legitimate — the finding is only the INTERNAL-route cases above.

Supporting concern (verify): neither RegistryPage nor ContentModerationPage is lazy-imported into any frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/*.tsx group (grep for the component names across src/routes returns no import; there is no registry.tsx or compliance.tsx route group). If the `/registry/*` and `/compliance/moderation/cases/:id` paths are not registered in the router, these full-reload navigations also land on unrouted URLs (not-found), making them broken links rather than merely slow ones. The implementer should confirm route registration while converting to useNavigate.

Fix vector: replace window.location.href with const navigate = useNavigate(); navigate('/registry/pets/...') for the internal cases, and register the target routes if missing. Cloud-verifiable (ppt-web: biome + typecheck). Confidence medium: the literals and reload behaviour are certain by static read; the route-non-registration is inferred from absent imports. Severity LOW (+1) refactor/UX smell per the skill score table.
